The Sets index follows [https://cardguide.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_CCG CardGuide] order for Decipher products. There is no Death Star II Sealed Deck; [[Death Star II Starter Decks]] released with [[Death Star II]]. Release months are from the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/collecting/ SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia] at starwarsccg.org.
